corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The reply sharply distinguishes a cosmological beginning from creation out of nothing and exposes the need for a principled explanation if God, but not reality itself, is exempted from ordinary causal demands. Principal limitation: It challenges causal asymmetry more fully than the distinct fine-tuning consideration, and it does not settle whether a necessary creator and an uncreated physical universe possess relevantly comparable explanatory properties. Live burden: The secular case must develop the parity beyond logical possibility by explaining which natural cosmological model is credible and why the proposed necessary-being distinction either fails or adds no explanatory advantage. Locked score: The very strong band reflects precise scope, appropriately modest possibility language, direct contact with an important creator inference, and charitable recognition of the strongest theistic distinction, with only bounded incompleteness concerning fine-tuning and positive cosmology.

corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The move supplies a specific, extensively evidenced mechanism for biological complexity, supports it with fossil and genetic considerations, and directly explains why apparent organic design need not independently indicate divine craftsmanship. Principal limitation: Its successful biological explanation does not itself address cosmic fine-tuning, the origin of natural laws, or the compatible possibility that a deity works through evolutionary processes, so its reach must remain carefully delimited. Live burden: The argument must preserve the distinction between defeating a biological design inference and disproving theism, while clarifying why mere compatibility with divine guidance supplies no additional predictive or explanatory evidence. Locked score: The very strong band reflects excellent empirical warrant, precise biological scope, powerful responsiveness, stable terminology, and fair treatment of compatibility, with only the necessary limitation that adjacent cosmological design questions remain outside this move.
